## Summary

Describe what changes for gallery visitors and maintainers.

## Checks

- [ ] Run `npm run verify` on Node 22.
- [ ] Check the affected pages on desktop and mobile.
- [ ] Verify download bytes and the selected vehicle variant.
- [ ] Review the image itself for Tesla or third-party logos, marks, and copyrighted characters.
- [ ] Confirm permission, output licence, author, source links, and source-licence evidence for every design.
- [ ] Confirm that no Tesla template, example, or vehicle image is copied or hotlinked.
- [ ] Regenerate the legal inventory if catalogue content changes.

Automated checks validate file properties and known hashes. A reviewer must inspect content and rights. Legal approval and public deployment remain Kai's release gates.
